context_entries_shape_check.name: context_entries_shape_check
context_entries_shape_check.value:
(
        ("context_entries"."kind" = 'file' AND "context_entries"."body" IS NOT NULL AND "context_entries"."fact_type" IS NULL AND "context_entries"."fact_value" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("context_entries"."kind" = 'fact' AND "context_entries"."body" IS NULL AND "context_entries"."fact_type" IN (
          'identity','decision','policy','constraint','preference','relationship','metric','reference','other'
        ) AND jsonb_typeof("context_entries"."fact_value") IN ('string','number','boolean'))
      )
